clips.title: The story
paras: Privateer Bloads in Stranglethorn Vale needs a fresh bundle of akiris reeds transported across the sea to Dustwallow Marsh. A contact named Privateer Groy has a client in Theramore Isle who wants more right away, and Bloads himself will not be heading there for a week.

Word has arrived from across the sea while you were away. Privateer Groy in Theramore Isle sent word to Privateer Bloads expressing satisfaction with the prior shipment of akiris reeds, noting that an interested client demands more immediately. With Bloads not scheduled to sail for Dustwallow Marsh for another week, he entrusts you with the packaged parcel of reeds to deliver by hand.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Friend, since I have you here, I got a message from Groy while you were gone. He mentioned bein' satisfied with the last shipment that arrived and has a client that wants some more of the stuff right away.
I won't be headin' to Theramore for a week, but if you're willin' to make the journey, there's no reason you can't take the stuff for me.
Feeling adventurous? You do know where Dustwallow Marsh is, doncha? I'd be careful though, Theramore can be dangerous if you're the wrong kind of crowd.

clips.title: Completion
paras: What?! I got a lot better things to do then talk to the likes of you, adventurer. Make it worth my while or get outta my face.
Huh? Bloads sent ya, huh? Well, whaddaya got for me?
Not bad, not bad at all. Another bundle will make my client quite happy.
I suppose yer next question's gonna be about money, huh, adventurer? Of course it is!
Here, take this coin and some advice: get off my docks.
